title: Undead Mobs
blurb: Mobs in the #minecraft:undead entity type tag. Undead mobs take extra damage from Smite, are hurt by Instant Health, and are healed by Instant Damage. Knowing which mobs qualify matters when choosing between Smite and Sharpness.
note: Tier A. 17 entity types carry #minecraft:undead in 26.2.
